title: An integral algebra of normalized Lefschetz operators
as_he_states: The author seeks relations for L and Λ and polynomial expressions for the projectors, using an exterior model over Z and later prescribed grading projectors.
plausible_today: The unit-step string algebra is the product of integral matrix algebras. A separate question is the precise integral order generated by exterior multiplication and raw symplectic contraction, with its factorial divisibility.
state_of_art: Kleiman1968 supplies the normalized rational correspondence formalism. Akhtar–Joshua uses a weighted rational sl2 algebra. Neither opened text identifies the two integral orders. The exterior top-power obstruction and matrix algebra were computed here.
why_open: The source leaves formula(6.5) blank and changes normalization without an explicit integral comparison. No historical reason beyond those visible gaps is asserted.
worth: Worth a focused run: an integral change-of-basis and denominator theorem would resolve a precise ambiguity with small exact calculations.

title: Can L alone recover the grading?
